coordinator.authority: Coordinates assignments, dependencies, workload, handoffs, escalations and QA oversight. Audits QA supervisors; does not silently change creator-approved canon or roster.

qa_supervisors.title: Quality Intake & Evidence Analyst
responsibilities: Identify defects, bugs, omissions, visual/integration issues and requirement mismatches
Document reproducible evidence, severity, expected versus actual behavior, affected systems and acceptance criteria
Maintain a clear issue record; do not assign production work directly or approve own findings as fixed
Send complete issue record to QA-2

qa_supervisors.title: Quality Triage & Routing Coordinator
responsibilities: Review QA-1 issue reports and clarify missing evidence
Identify the responsible production department and agent
Assign priority, dependencies, repair scope and acceptance criteria
Track assignment and route corrected work to QA-3
Re-route when ownership or dependency analysis changes

qa_supervisors.title: Independent Verification & Release Analyst
responsibilities: Independently test the corrected artifact against the original issue and acceptance criteria
Record evidence and pass/fail decision; never approve unsupported claims
On failure, route directly to the responsible production agent for another correction cycle
Return to QA-1 when the defect definition, evidence or scope needs reassessment
Release only verified versions and keep failed versions out of downstream production

communications.qa_contact: all specialists may contact any QA supervisor or Trinity
